name: KITTI-360 — 360-Degree Vision and Point Cloud Benchmark
description: Large-scale suburban autonomous driving dataset developed by Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and the University of Tübingen as the successor to KITTI. Features comprehensive 360-degree sensory input recorded over 73.7 km of driving trajectories using two 180-degree fisheye cameras, two front perspective cameras, and a Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR. Provides dense 2D/3D semantic-instance annotations, bounding primitives, and camera poses for mobile robotics, scene completion, and novel view synthesis.
